summary: Closed the remaining in-cluster half of the audit's last open gap by reading the leader's recorded-accepted bookkeeping, and recorded the split so only the storage-level entry point stays open. LeaderState::get_min_all_accepted_idx is the minimum over the accepted_indexes vector, and the source asserts that vector is initialised for every node (its expect message reads Should be all initialised to 0) while set_promise rewrites the sender's entry on every promise; a truthful replica therefore keeps its own accepted index inside the minimum, so trim cannot pass it and no re-synchronization request below a trim-produced compacted index can arise inside the cluster. That closes, by source, the sub-route the trim child's gap named as a peer compacted while its recorded values were still truthful, and it joins the executed half already recorded: a replica re-synchronized below a compacted index is not refused and does not abort, it receives a complete snapshot built from the empty part of the log and a shortened decided log (receipt 0b9c22ae5fb043588aa7efa3ad009b25 events 152-162, guarded result event 162 with panicked false), while the abort this lineage did produce belongs to the public snapshot call on a NoSnapshot instance and stays under its own question. The trim child's account was rewritten as a successor with that split in its own answers, its counterevidence and limitations now distinguishing what is executed, what is closed by source, and what is untested, and the trim-bound fact was revised so its conditions carry the initialisation basis rather than the observed drift alone. No execution was requested and nothing was run, so the remaining work is explicitly left as work: the storage-level routes a caller could use below a compacted index (a direct range read, a store-level trim), the forwarded-compaction and peer-sampling variants, the delivery of a forwarded Compaction::Snapshot to a NoSnapshot instance, and the bookkeeping detail that the revised trim-bound fact's affected uses were not enumerated in the same update.
